name: What are common signs that my water heater needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my water heater needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your water heater may need repair include a lack of hot water, inconsistent water temperatures, strange noises coming from the unit like rumbling or popping, rusty or discolored hot water, or a metallic odor. Leaks around the base of the water heater are also a clear indication of a problem. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage and more costly repairs down the line. If you notice any of these symptoms, it's best to have a professional inspect your unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lack of hot water, strange noises, leaks, or discolored water are common signs. Early detection can prevent more significant issues.
